metadata.title: कैसे बनता है तवा केंकड़ा और मछली।How to cook crab and fish on a Tawa।The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
This time in the tribal kitchen we take you to a reserve forest in Ranchi district of Jharkhand. The small village of Horhap (situated inside the reserve forest) has 3 major tribes, Munda, Uraon and Santhali. In this episode, we cook fish and crabs caught fresh from the river by tribal boys.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below:: 

Facebook:: https://www.facebook.com/mainbhibharat/

Instagram:: https://www.instagram.com/mainbhibharat/

Twitter:: https://twitter.com/mbb_plus

Website:: http://www.mainbhibharat.co.in


#MainBhiBharat #crabcooking #tawafish
